product_overview: Watum is an academic management web application for administrators and staff to manage institutional academic data and review schedules. It also provides public availability and demo routes, plus authenticated access to dashboards, records, enrollments, grades, users, and conflict audits.
core_goals: Sign in with email and password to access the academic management app
Review academic dashboard summaries, schedules, and conflict indicators
Manage academic master data such as faculties, study programs, courses, lecturers, students, classrooms, and users
Create, edit, search, filter, and delete enrollment and grade records
Inspect weekly schedules, room availability, and scheduling conflicts
Use responsive navigation and theme controls to move between app sections

features.name: Public App Access and Availability
features.description: Users can access public routes to confirm the app is running, view the demo page, and verify internal routes are not exposed publicly.
user_flows: Navigate to /health -> See a successful health response
Navigate to /ready -> See a successful readiness response
Navigate to /demo/playwright -> See a visible demo heading
Navigate to /test -> See that the internal route is not available in production preview

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Users log in with email and password from the root route, and invalid credentials keep them on the login experience with a clear error.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit the login form -> See dashboard content after successful login
Navigate to / -> Fill in email -> Fill in password with invalid credentials -> Submit the login form -> See an authentication error and remain on the login experience

features.name: Academic Dashboard
features.description: Authenticated users can review summary information, upcoming schedules, and conflict indicators from the main dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Log in -> Review dashboard summary information -> Inspect schedule cards -> Inspect conflict indicators
Navigate to / -> Log in -> Review role-appropriate navigation groups -> Confirm available app sections update

features.name: Responsive Navigation And Theme
features.description: Users can open or close navigation, switch between light and dark theme, and move between major app sections.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the mobile menu or sidebar -> Select a navigation item -> See the page heading and available actions update
Navigate to / -> Switch the theme -> See the interface change between light and dark modes
Navigate to / -> Close the mobile menu or sidebar -> Continue using the current section

features.name: Faculty Management
features.description: Authenticated users can search, create, edit, and delete faculty records.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Log in -> Navigate to Faculties -> Search faculty records -> Open a faculty form -> Fill faculty fields -> Save changes -> See the updated faculty list
Navigate to / -> Log in -> Navigate to Faculties -> Select faculty records -> Delete selected faculty records -> See the list refresh

features.name: Study Program Management
features.description: Authenticated users can manage study programs and associate them with faculties.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Log in -> Navigate to Study Programs -> Search study programs -> Open a study program form -> Select related faculty options -> Save changes -> See the updated study program list
Navigate to / -> Log in -> Navigate to Study Programs -> Open a study program form -> Modify fields -> Save changes -> See the updated record
Navigate to / -> Log in -> Navigate to Study Programs -> Select a study program -> Delete the record -> See the list refresh

features.name: Course Management
features.description: Authenticated users can search, create, edit, paginate, and delete course records.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Log in -> Navigate to Courses -> Search course records -> Open a course form -> Fill course details -> Save changes -> See the updated course list
Navigate to / -> Log in -> Navigate to Courses -> Select one or more courses -> Delete the selected courses -> See the course list refresh
Navigate to / -> Log in -> Navigate to Courses -> Move through the paginated list -> Review more course records

features.name: Lecturer Management
features.description: Authenticated users can search, create, edit, and delete lecturer records.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Log in -> Navigate to Lecturers -> Search lecturer records -> Open a lecturer form -> Fill lecturer details -> Save changes -> See the updated lecturer list
Navigate to / -> Log in -> Navigate to Lecturers -> Select a lecturer record -> Delete the record -> See the list refresh

features.name: Student Management
features.description: Authenticated users can manage students and assign them to study programs.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Log in -> Navigate to Students -> Search students -> Open a student form -> Select related study program data -> Save changes -> See the updated student list
Navigate to / -> Log in -> Navigate to Students -> Create or edit a student -> Change the study program assignment -> Save changes -> See the updated record
Navigate to / -> Log in -> Navigate to Students -> Select a student record -> Delete the record -> See the list refresh

features.name: Classroom Management
features.description: Authenticated users can search, create, edit, and delete classrooms while managing room type and capacity data.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Log in -> Navigate to Classrooms -> Search classrooms -> Open a classroom form -> Choose room type and capacity fields -> Save changes -> See the updated classroom list
Navigate to / -> Log in -> Navigate to Classrooms -> Select a classroom record -> Delete the record -> See the list refresh

features.name: Enrollment Management
features.description: Authenticated users can search, filter, create, edit, and delete enrollments while reviewing availability and conflict feedback.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Log in -> Navigate to Enrollments -> Search or filter enrollments -> Open an enrollment form -> Choose course, lecturer, student, room, day, and time slot fields -> Review conflict or availability feedback -> Save changes -> See the updated enrollment list
Navigate to / -> Log in -> Navigate to Enrollments -> Open an enrollment form -> Adjust schedule-related fields -> Review conflict or availability feedback -> See updated feedback before saving
Navigate to / -> Log in -> Navigate to Enrollments -> Select an enrollment record -> Delete the record -> See the list refresh

features.name: Grade Management
features.description: Authenticated users can manage grade records and review calculated grade outcomes.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Log in -> Navigate to Grades -> Search grade records -> Open a grade form -> Create or edit grade inputs -> Review calculated grade outcome -> Save changes -> See the updated grade list
Navigate to / -> Log in -> Navigate to Grades -> Select a grade record -> Delete the record -> See the list refresh

features.name: User Management
features.description: Authorized users can search, create, edit, and delete application users while assigning roles and identity fields.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Log in -> Navigate to Users -> Search users -> Open a user form -> Assign role or identity fields -> Save changes -> See the updated user list
Navigate to / -> Log in -> Navigate to Users -> Select a user record -> Delete the record -> See the list refresh

features.name: Schedule Calendar And Conflict Audit
features.description: Authenticated users can inspect weekly schedules, room availability, and conflict details.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Log in -> Navigate to calendar or conflict audit views -> Filter schedules or conflicts -> Review room and session cards -> Inspect conflict explanations
Navigate to / -> Log in -> Navigate to calendar or conflict audit views -> Select a conflict detail -> Review the explanation -> Return to the schedule view

known_limitations.issue: Most authenticated app features require valid seed data and database connectivity, so unauthenticated TestSprite runs may be limited to login, public demo, and health/readiness coverage.
known_limitations.impact: Full CRUD and calendar flows may not be reachable without credentials and a running MySQL database seeded with usable users.

known_limitations.issue: /test is an internal route that is expected to return 404 in production preview.
known_limitations.impact: Production frontend testing should not treat /test as a public navigable page.
